about: Single source of the GLM-5.3-Flash (E192) serving profiles on a (1, 4) Blackhole mesh. Rule and readers: tt/serving_profiles.py. Update with tools/serving_profiles.py (ingest a capacity probe, refresh, render-yaml); never edit the numbers in tt-model.yaml or the scripts by hand.
weights_revision_source: HF download metadata of the E192 build (~/glm53-flash-bringup/ckpt/glm53_flash_e192_fp8/.cache/huggingface/download/*.metadata): the parent commit every stage ran against
expert_set: E192: 192 of 288 routed experts per MoE layer (tt/e192_mask.json, mask of autotrust/GLM5.3-Flash-E192-DGX-Spark)

budget.status: MEASURED for 1 slot: free_after_load_bytes and dsa_bytes_per_block come from the combo_a_kv_dense4_g4 1-slot capacity probe (doc/vllm/capacity/s1); reserve_bytes = the 1,024 MiB serving workspace of the G9 probes. A slot count without a measured entry uses this rule.

evidence.kda_bytes_per_slot: doc/full_model/memory_budget.json kda_state_per_slot_bytes (34 layers x 16 local heads x 128 x 128 fp32)
evidence.reserve_bytes: serving workspace 1,024 MiB: every G9 probe (doc/vllm/capacity/s*) ran at --workspace-mib 1024 (stage 8 review #2: 832 MiB failed in the warm-up prefill, doc/datatype_sweep/capacity/combo_a_kv_s1_337920_ws832)

measured_note: slots -> {pool_blocks, max_model_len_tested, prompt_len, copy_accuracy, free_at_prefill_peak_bytes, evidence, date}; written by tools/serving_profiles.py ingest from a COMPLETED capacity probe (load, bind, warm-up, capture, longest prefill, traced decode). A measured entry wins over the budget rule for that slot count.

sharded.description: block-sharded DSA latent with fp8 e4m3 rows (tt/dsa_shard.py): global block b on die b % 4, 576-byte rows (512 latent + 64 control columns); pool keys, indexer and top-512 selection replicated. 2,288 B per token per die (replicated: 6,336). Costs about +2.9 ms per decode token at 16K (doc/context_contract.json dsa_block_sharded_fp8).

budget.status: measured (G9, profile p300x2-1m, 2026-10-21): dsa_bytes_per_block and free_after_load_bytes from the 1-slot capacity probe of this layout (doc/vllm/capacity/s1_p300x2-1m, 1,048,515-token copy prompt, copy 1.0); reserve_bytes = the 600 MiB workspace of that probe (the DSA constants, 180,549,632 B, come out of it).

evidence.reserve_bytes: doc/multichip_decoder/dsa_shard/capacity/fp8_s1_1048576/capacity.json workspace_mib 600 (1,048,576 tokens, copy 1.0; 194 MB free at the warm-up peak)

profiles.name: p300x2
profiles.description: Two p300 boards (4 dies, tensor parallel 4), 16 sequences sharing one DSA pool.

profiles.name: p300x2-long
profiles.description: Two p300 boards, one sequence, the largest context the device DRAM allows.

profiles.name: p300x2-1m
profiles.description: Two p300 boards, one sequence, the advertised 1,048,576-token context with the block-sharded fp8 DSA cache (slower decode than p300x2-long).

profiles.name: p300x2-wide
profiles.description: Two p300 boards, 32 sequences sharing one DSA pool (the KDA state of 32 slots takes 1.1 GiB per die).

profiles.name: p150x4
profiles.description: Four p150 boards (4 dies), the same (1, 4) mesh and numbers as p300x2 (sizing rule); not run on p150 hardware.

default_profile_note: p300x2 (16 slots) stays the default: single-user decode 69.9 ms per token and 79 output tokens/s at 16 users. p300x2-long for the fastest single-user decode, p300x2-wide for 32 users, p300x2-1m for the full 1,048,576-token context (doc/vllm_integration/README.md, Serving profile choice).
trace_region_note: Per-profile trace regions (stage 10), measured by the stage-10 t21 probes (no DSA decode buckets at S >= 2): 64 MiB at 1 slot (capture 44.9 MiB), 96 MiB at 16 slots (87.3 MiB), 160 MiB at 32 slots (101.6 MiB); doc/vllm/capacity/s10_s1, s10_s16, s10_s32. Stage 12: with the opt-in per-row DSA decode buckets (GLM53_DSA_ROW_BUCKETS=1, 2 widths, cut at 16,384) p300x2 (16 slots) captures 88.1 MiB of its 96 MiB; by default (row buckets off) it captures 83.9 MiB; 3 widths took 95.6 MiB and overflowed with the sampler traces. See trace_budget and doc/decode_perf_stage12/README.md.

trace_budget.about: Measured decode captures without DSA points, per slot count (bytes per die), for the row-mode DSA fit check (tests/test_dsa_buckets_host.py: base + tt/dsa_buckets.row_dsa_trace_estimate + sampler <= the profile's trace region). Not read by the serving code.

decode_no_dsa_source.16: stage 12, 83.9 MiB: ag_persistent on, MoE buckets 1/2/4/8/16 (~/glm53-flash-bringup/logs/s12/dec_ab1.log)
decode_no_dsa_source.32: stage 10 t21, 101.6 MiB, trace_bytes_model_plus_greedy_sampler of doc/vllm/capacity/s10_s32/capacity.json: ag_persistent off, per-layer MoE sentinel, sampler included (the check adds it again). An upper bound for the stage-12 code (ag_persistent took -2.6 MiB at 16 slots)

trace_budget.sampler_source: stage-9 G9 probe: about 0.8 MiB of sampler traces (tt/dsa_buckets.py trace-region model)
